candidates.original_title: The use of category and exemplar knowledge in the solution of anchoring tasks
candidates.description: An anchor selectively increases the accessibility of anchor-consistent knowledge, measured by faster lexical decision responses to anchor-consistent words following a comparative judgment.
candidates.citation_sentence: the one candidate test that we could identify in the literature to provide such a 'signature test' was the one described in Mussweiler and Strack (2000a, Studies 1 & 2), and evaluated in the present manuscript.
candidates.notes: Conceptual replication using Continuous IDentification (CID) task instead of Lexical Decision Task (LDT); temperature domain only.
